title: Always, ask, never: a team's standing rules
description: A servicing team owes a borrower a refund. Its owner said three things once. Always check the payee's account: that step holds its grant and runs unasked. Ask me first before a refund is paid: the run puts the question to the owner and waits, with the payment and its reconciliation pending. Never pay to an account that is not the borrower's own: that route is refused by decision, though it is the cheaper one.
